scheme_name: Medical Expenses for Treatment of Major Ailments (O.B.O.C.W.W.B)
other_conditions: Should have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year
Should not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law
Should be a registered member of the Odisha Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board or a dependent of the member
Beneficiary should be registered at least for one year in line of the Odisha State Treatment Fund
Should suffer from any major diseases
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹3,00,000 financial assistance for treatment of major ailments.
